summary: Two critical wrong-value defects found: misspelled 'Незалязваща звезда' and wrong galaxy name 'Водовар' instead of 'Водовъртеж' in solutions.

defects.description: Problem 1 Part A table row shows 'Незалияазва звезда' but should be 'Незалязваща звезда' (non-eclipsed star). This is a semantic/spelling error that changes the meaning of the row.
Problem 1 Part B solution table shows galaxy M51 named as 'М51 (Водовар)' but should be 'М51 (Водовъртеж)' (Whirlpool Galaxy). Водовар/Водовъртеж refers to different constellations.
Problem 1 Part A solution table shows 'Незаявяваща звезда' but should be 'Незалязваща звезда' - additional misspelling/OCR error in the solution.
